column1: # City Folk furniture ac-plus adds (pc/tools/cf_furniture.py): the pieces the GameCube has no piece of the same name for.
# item = 0x3700 + 4 * slot. record: its index in the disc's Item/item.arc item.bin (name and price come from there).
# size 1x1/2x1/2x2; kind plain/chair/sofa/bed (a sofa is two tiles wide, as the GameCube's; a one-tile one is a chair); series: the GameCube HRA series it counts for (OTHER: none);
# group: Nook's shop group A/B/C (City Folk's rarity tier 1/2/3; what he had no tier for, from Gracie, Redd, events...: spread over A, B, C);
# height: its top, for things put on it, in City Folk units (0: nothing goes on it); file/model on the disc.
# does: tv (shows the programs on its screen), stereo (takes K.K. songs), inst:N (plays the town tune, sAdo_FurnitureInst instrument N, as the GameCube's instruments)
